title: What are the causes of burning sensation with urination? Dr Manohar T, Columbia Asia Hospitals
description: Dr. Manohar T - Consultant - Urology, Columbia Asia Hospital - Whitefield

asr.full_text: I am Dr. T Manohar, Chief of Urology Services, Columbia Hospital, Whitefield. There are various causes of burning sensation starting from urinary tract infection to the. Malignancy of the prostate. So generally speaking, the commonest condition in the. In younger age group is infection, in the middle and adult age group is infection of. The prostate and tumour of the prostate and enlargement of the prostate. In the older age group you can find about the cancer of the prostate producing the condition. Called as dysuria and pain while passing urine. So generally speaking this pain can produce as a minimum symptoms to the severe symptoms. And obstruction and these can lead to fever and then obstruction and then even the stone. Can produce us symptoms like dysuria.
